# Receiptle

> Receiptle is a personal finance tracker that turns Gmail receipts and
> uploaded documents into structured transactions. It is a single-user SaaS:
> the marketing landing is public, everything else is behind authentication.

Receiptle connects to a Gmail account over read-only OAuth, extracts amounts,
merchants and dates from receipt emails with AI (xAI Grok), categorizes them,
tracks recurring subscriptions, and shows a multi-currency dashboard with a
chat assistant (OpenRouter). Supported content here is the public landing page
and the product documentation; the application itself requires an account.

## Public pages

- [Receiptle](https://receiptle.com/): product landing (Spanish, the default).
- [Receiptle (English)](https://receiptle.com/en/): the same landing in English.
- [Privacy policy](https://receiptle.com/privacy): what data is read, stored
  and never shared.

## Documentation

- [Receiptle docs](https://federicodeniard-receiptle.mintlify.app/): product
  documentation — Gmail connection, transaction extraction, subscriptions,
  reports and billing.

## Source code

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/federicodeniard/receiptle): the
  self-hostable codebase (React 19 + Bun SPA, Astro landing, Deno Edge
  Functions, Postgres/Supabase).

## Optional

- [Create an account](https://receiptle.com/register): sign-up flow, requires
  human interaction.
- [Sign in](https://receiptle.com/login): authentication page.
